name: Deep Stick : Spatial Drum Experience
summary:
Your drum kit, anywhere in your home.
DeepStick places a full-size virtual drum kit in your real room with mixed reality passthrough. Real hands and objects naturally hide the drums behind them, so the kit feels truly there.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Kick, snare, three toms, hi-hat, ride and two crashes
- Touch controllers or hand tracking alone
- Velocity-sensitive hits
- Pedals on controller buttons, a keyboard or a USB/Bluetooth foot pedal
- Move, turn and raise each drum or the whole kit

A KIT FOR EVERY ROOM
